title: Unified effective authority control plane governed evidence pipeline

phases.objective: Build and review bounded repository authority-source candidates, compose them with the bounded live catalog observer, preserve deterministic Resource Graph safety evidence, and compile one shared no-secret projection-eligibility contract for Dynamic Tabs, Dashboard, and Tool Catalog without granting execution authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A previously captured complete no-secret array of eight canonical authority source snapshots
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Eight deterministic bounded repository source candidates and one review-required index are validated or written without final manifest binding or any runtime effect.
steps: Load a source snapshot array directly or from snapshots, sources, or source_bundle.sources.
Require exactly one snapshot for every registered authority source family.
Validate complete pagination, bounded records, timestamps, evidence references, and explicit no-effect/no-secret markers.
Reject lexical or realpath escapes, final or intermediate symlinks, unsafe existing output types, sensitive values, excessive records, and rendered outputs above 8 MiB.
Render deterministic source documents and a candidate index containing paths, content hashes, record counts, and capture timestamps.
Default to dry-run and write only when the caller explicitly supplies --write.
Keep the index review-required and not dispatch-ready until a later change binds reviewed ancestor and Git blob identities.
assertions: The builder emits exactly eight source documents and one candidate index.
The builder emits neither blob_sha nor the final repository manifest contract.
The candidate index requires post-commit blob binding and human review.
Dry-run creates no repository files and write mode remains inside the canonical repository real path.
T001 and T002 remain open and migration_apply_authorized remains false.
No live collector, SQL, database/provider mutation, credential payload read, external write, deployment, Production promotion, runtime authority change, or task closure occurs.

e2e_journeys.actor: approved UEACP evidence operator and GitHub Actions
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: UEACP Governed Operational Evidence Cycle contract job or explicitly approved workflow dispatch from main
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A SHA-bound no-secret packet reaches ready_for_human_ownership_review without migration, authority, provider, credential, deployment, Production, or task mutation.
steps: Validate the source manifest contract, exact dispatch SHA, reviewed ancestor identity, and exact eight source-family bindings.
Reject symbolic links, non-regular files, repository escapes, a manifest larger than 1 MiB, or a source larger than 8 MiB.
Verify every source Git blob SHA and current file content SHA-256.
Convert reviewed repository definitions into current-observation canonical source snapshots.
Reject incomplete or conflicting authority path contracts.
Create a thirty-minute read-only authorization after variable, typed-confirmation, and Environment gates.
Expose BACKEND_API_KEY only to the bounded live catalog observer step.
Run the existing bounded SELECT-only live catalog observer and same-cycle readback.
Adapt the catalog observation and compose the canonical governed evidence packet.
Scan every available JSON evidence file for regular-file identity, root containment, bounded size, valid JSON, and sensitive values.
Upload evidence only when the independent artifact safety step publishes safe=true.
Enforce the read-only packet decision after the guarded upload step.
assertions: Pull requests run only contract tests and cannot execute the live job.
No push, schedule, issue-comment, or workflow-run event can execute the live job.
The source manifest must pin an ancestor of the exact dispatch SHA and exactly eight canonical source families.
A source change after the reviewed ref fails the current content binding.
Missing control fields, blob drift, content drift, path escape, symlinks, unsafe file types, oversized files, duplicate families, and sensitive values fail closed.
Temporary evidence is rooted in RUNNER_TEMP and propagated through GITHUB_ENV.
BACKEND_API_KEY appears in exactly one step-level environment binding.
No artifact is uploaded when no evidence exists or any evidence file is malformed, sensitive, escaped, unsafe, or oversized.
The live observer remains SELECT/WITH/SHOW-only and performs same-cycle readback.
The packet keeps T001 and T002 incomplete and migration_apply_authorized false.
The global test manifest and deterministic frontend generated artifacts are not changed by this focused wave.

No SQL mutation, provider call outside the explicitly approved observer, credential payload read, external write, deployment, Production promotion, runtime cutover, legacy removal, or automatic task closure occurs.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: T043 is supported by deterministic property-style evidence proving inheritance and restriction invariants without enabling runtime enforcement or granting authority.
steps: Evaluate an authoritative bounded Resource Graph fixture under deterministic input permutations and a cycle.
Verify active branch and root deny restrictions take precedence over inheritance.
Verify wildcard and operation-specific restriction semantics plus expiry and revocation handling.
Inject cross-Tenant contamination and verify fail-closed rejection.
Apply depth and inheritance-policy bounds and verify traversal cannot widen beyond the approved contract.
Confirm the evaluator emits no authority grant, runtime authority change, automatic write, provider call, credential read, or secret inclusion.
assertions: Input row order does not alter the resolved graph projection.
Cycles do not duplicate resolved nodes.
Active deny restrictions win before inherited access reaches a descendant.
Wildcard restrictions apply to all operations while operation-specific restrictions do not leak to other operations.
Expired or revoked restrictions do not act as current denies.
Any cross-Tenant node contamination blocks the graph even when the foreign node is disconnected.
Depth bounds and inheritance-policy allowlists are hard limits.
Root restrictions terminate resolution with stable reason codes.
The test changes no runtime enforcement state and performs no mutation.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: T032, T033, and T034 are backed by one deterministic no-secret compiler that projects Dynamic Tabs, Dashboard, and Tool Catalog visibility/action eligibility without becoming a PEP or granting execution authority.
steps: Load a typed Effective Authority Manifest with explicit decision, timestamps, no-secret attestation, readiness, and projection eligibility.
Fail closed on missing or unsupported manifest evidence before any surface candidate is inspected.
Compile Dynamic Tabs and Dashboard visibility from the same manifest projection eligibility rather than local UI policy.
Compile Tool Catalog visibility separately from action eligibility.
Require ready or canary-ready decision plus execution projection eligibility and execution readiness before an action can be marked eligible for later PEP evaluation.
Return zero candidates and inspect no registrations for ineligible, expired, or stale surfaces.
Return deterministic secret-safe public projection metadata without emitting execution authorization or an action grant.
assertions: Dynamic Tabs, Dashboard, and Tool Catalog consume one shared compiler rather than separate policy engines.
Ineligible, expired, or stale surfaces reveal no candidate identities, counts, malformed shapes, or duplicate-registration errors.
Visible surface registrations are deterministic and ambiguous duplicate keys fail closed.
Tool Catalog visibility is independent from action eligibility.
Shadow-ready authority can remain visible where projection policy permits it but cannot make a tool action eligible.
Action eligibility requires execution projection eligibility and execution readiness and never implies execution_authorized.
The compiler requires explicit secretsIncluded=false, evaluatedAt, expiresAt, and a supported manifest decision.
Secret-like keys, authorization values, private keys, URL credentials, and secret query parameters do not enter public projection output.
The compiler creates no authority, emits no action grant, enables no runtime enforcement, performs no provider call, and mutates no database.

phases.objective: Capture all eight sources under explicit read-only authorization, review and merge source documents, finalize a reviewed ancestor and Git blob-bound manifest, configure the protected Environment, and separately authorize one bounded Production read-only evidence cycle.
